landing.subtitle: Tabletop Miniatures Wargame
landing.heroDescription: A tactical miniatures game set in the World of Warcraft universe. Build your army, master your faction, and dominate the table.
landing.chooseAllegianceSubtitle: Every faction fights differently. Every choice matters.
landing.featureFactionsDesc: From Stormwind's paladins to the Lich King's undead legions. Each with unique mechanics, units, and playstyles.
landing.featureAIDesc: Ask questions about any rule, keyword, or interaction. Get instant answers powered by AI.
landing.featureScenariosDesc: 9 deployment maps across 3 scenario types. Annihilation, Assassination, and Hold the Line.
landing.everythingYouNeedSubtitle: Rules, army lists, deployment maps, and an AI that knows it all.
landing.readyForWarSubtitle: Dive into the rules, pick your faction, and build your army.

factions.description: 5 grand factions wage war across Azeroth. Pick your allegiance, then select a subfaction to specialize your army.

scenarios.title: Battle Scenarios
scenarios.description: 9 deployment maps across 3 scenario types. Roll or choose before each battle.
scenarios.annihilationDesc: Total war. Destroy the enemy army. The player who eliminates the most points of enemy models wins.
scenarios.assassinationDesc: Targeted strikes. Each player secretly selects an enemy Hero as their assassination target. Kill the target to win.
scenarios.holdTheLineDesc: Territorial control. Capture and hold objective markers placed across the battlefield. Points scored each round for controlled objectives.

builder.title: Army Builder
builder.description: Build, save, and manage your army lists.
builder.noArmiesDesc: Create your first army list to get started.
builder.pickSubfaction: Now pick a subfaction to specialize your army.
builder.rosterEmptyDesc: Add units from the catalog to start building your army.
